tasks.title: Make the playbooks and tier docs decide from the effective tiers
tasks.summary: Plan v6. Wording only: run.md, wave.md steps 7, 8 and 10, queue-and-gate.md section 5 (both bullets), the scope doc's defaults, closing-an-epic.md's per-tier close and the CHANGELOG entry say the effective tiers (declared plus the overlay), and the overlay bullet scopes its no-overlay list.
tasks.objective: Close two second-closing-review findings, and the sibling sentences the plan-v6 sweep found, by rewording in place. Add no section, flag, code or test. (1) f-bs-check-tiers/integration-1c55ad6b: run.md's post-merge block and wave.md step 10 decide from the declared checks file, while `bs checks post-merge`, `bs wave check --checks` and `bs queue run --checks` read the effective tiers (declared plus overlay, D2 and D8); on the overlay-only path an epic session following run.md never starts the batch and held tasks stall. Both sentences are to say "effective". (2) f-bs-check-tiers/integration-7a01ece7: queue-and-gate.md section 5's overlay bullet lists a `--separate-git-dir` layout among the layouts that refuse writes and then names a class of it that resolves an overlay; the list is to scope each layout as D8 does, with its linked worktrees, and to except that class. (3) Sweep sites, the same defect in sibling sentences: wave.md steps 7 and 8, queue-and-gate.md section 5's `"tier"` bullet, docs/specs/check-tiers-scope.md's Defaults and closing-an-epic.md's per-tier close. (4) CHANGELOG.md's Unreleased Check tiers entry, by the epic session's decision: the same two claims, which a user reads first.

(b) In .claude/skills/bs/wave.md step 10, '(one with no post-merge or pre-release entry, or an empty one)' becomes '(one whose effective tiers, declared or from the tier overlay, hold no post-merge or pre-release entry, or an empty one)', and 'Once a later tier exists the pre-merge tier is the pre-landing test' becomes 'Once the effective tiers hold one, the pre-merge tier is the pre-landing test'. functional_clauses: run.md's post-merge block and wave.md step 10 decide from the effective tiers (the declared tiers plus the tier overlay), so run.md tells the epic session to start `bs checks post-merge` on each landing when the post-merge entry comes only from the overlay, and step 10 says when the pre-merge tier replaces `--test-cmd` as the queue decides it.
queue-and-gate.md section 5's overlay bullet names each no-overlay layout with its linked worktrees and excepts the one known wrong class from the layouts that refuse writes.

Each passage criteria 3 to 7 name says an absent tier is `pre-merge` only beside the tier overlay, and decides the gate, the brief, the queue or `--tier` from the effective tiers, not from the file's labels alone.
nonfunctional_clauses: Read factory/specs/active/bs-check-tiers/epic-spec.md before starting: D2, D8 and the section '### Plan v6 — second closing-review fixes'. They state what the merged code does, and these docs follow them. Do not edit it: it sits outside every task's claims. Put one Progress line for this task in the result `notes` (what changed, and anything a later task must know); the epic session copies it in at merge.

Base: the epic's integration branch `bs/bs-check-tiers/integration` at 1948abdf or later, where every task of plan v5 has merged. If a passage a criterion names is not on the base as quoted, stop and report it in `notes` instead of rewriting another passage.

Diff budget (#511): `diff_lines` caps the non-test lines of the diff only. This task changes no test file, so every changed line counts. Re-wrap at most the source lines a changed sentence spans, not the rest of its paragraph. At plan time, re-wrapping those lines for every criterion measured 72 changed lines, under the cap. Re-wrapping each touched paragraph to its end measured 197, because the CHANGELOG entry and section 7a's per-tier paragraph are long. A line longer than its neighbours passes the doc checks: task-21 left one in closing-an-epic.md section 7a and one in queue-and-gate.md section 5.

No test is added or changed. Each criterion names the grep that checks it: run each one and put the command and its output in `notes`. The existing doc guards that read these files run in the full suite and must pass unchanged. Among them are docCommands.test.ts (every documented `bs` command and flag must exist in usage.ts), docErrorCodes.test.ts (every backticked dotted token must be a code raised in source), checkTiersScopeDoc.test.ts, checkTiersPlaybook.test.ts, wavePlaybook.test.ts, playbookCitations.test.ts and handbackPreflight.test.ts.

checkTiersPlaybook.test.ts reads run.md's post-merge block from the line that starts `**Post-merge and held tasks.**` to the next line that starts with `**` or `#`. Keep that label at the start of its line, and start no wrapped line of the block's first paragraph with `**` or `#`.

Before hand-back run, in the foreground and in full: `pnpm run build`, root `pnpm run test` (the whole suite, never a scoped file), `pnpm run typecheck`, `pnpm run typecheck:test` and `pnpm exec biome check .` from the repo root (the whole repo, never a scoped path); report each exit code and the tail of each output. Run the full suite through `bs heavy run` so it takes the machine's heavy lock.
Also run `bash scripts/check.sh` and read the tail of its output, not only its exit code; name every step it printed as SKIP.

Weaken nothing: add no `.skip`, `.only`, `.todo`, `.fails`, `retry`, quarantine list or flaky marker; raise no `testTimeout`, `hookTimeout`, `timeout_ms`, `waitForLines` default, `DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_MS` or any other timeout; remove, loosen or reorder no existing assertion, check, gate stage, grader, judge, review round or verifier.
Reword in place: the only added sentence is step 8's, in criterion 3. Add no section, heading, flag or test, and change no heading. Cite no line numbers in the docs.

Open source, any stack: no other project's name, no client code and no absolute home-directory path (`/Users/...`, `/home/...`) in any committed file, and no sentence that names a per-stack tier default or makes anything require GitHub Actions.
Add no runtime or dev dependency.
Do not edit anything under factory/policies/.
In CHANGELOG.md change only the two sentences criterion 7 names. This task changes no behaviour, so it adds no entry and no line to any other entry.
